Type 1-R Radiant Thruster.name: Type 1-R Radiant Thruster
Type 1-R Radiant Thruster.description: This is the tiniest Wanderer reverse engine. Like all their engines, it works in part by radiating excess heat, and as a result it doubles as a cooler for your ship.

Type 2-R Radiant Thruster.name: Type 2-R Radiant Thruster
Type 2-R Radiant Thruster.description: Wanderer engines work by transferring excess heat from the ship into the exhaust plasma. When not providing thrust, the engines still serve as a cooling system.

Type 3-R Radiant Thruster.name: Type 3-R Radiant Thruster
Type 3-R Radiant Thruster.description: Most engines this size generate a considerable amount of heat, but the Wanderers have developed a way of using the engine itself to vent extra heat from a ship, generating extra propulsive force in the process.

Type 4-R Radiant Thruster.name: Type 4-R Radiant Thruster
Type 4-R Radiant Thruster.description: This is the largest reverse engine that the Wanderers have developed. Its incredibly efficient design allows it to cool your ship even while it is firing.
